messages:
Elliot Park: hey all  first day as a backend/platform engineer (PST). quick intro: used to do infra at a gaming studio. fun fact: salsa dancer on weekends :musical_score: :wave

Elliot Park: small setup issues — Okta invite arrived but MFA push never shows up. Also need access to repo 'platform-core' and to the staging cluster. anyone who handles hardware requests? would love a standing desk converter if possible.

Maria Santos: welcome Elliot!! :tada: Im Maria (your manager). Ill set up a 1:1 and intro to the team later today. @Samir can help with cluster access; @IT Support for hardware/MFA. Were excited to have you.

Samir Patel: hey Elliot  added you to the staging-k8s group and started the RBAC approval. you should see a separate invite in ~5m. for repo perms, open a GH access ticket with your handle and Ill approve.

IT Support: Hi Elliot  welcome! For the MFA issue try removing and re-adding the device in Okta (Profile > Devices). If push still fails, we can enable SMS or a temporary bypass for 24h. For the standing desk, please confirm building/desk number and whether you want the electric converter or the manual one.

Elliot Park: thanks  SMS bypass would be great so I can get started. desk is 4th floor, desk 42. electric converter preferred.

HR Bot: Welcome to Redwood, Elliot! Swag and equipment requests queued. Please complete the onboarding form: https://intranet.redwood/onboard.

DevEx Bot: Onboarding docs: https://docs.redwood/infrastructure/onboarding. Start with '01-credentials' and '03-first-pr'. If you plan to edit docs, ping Priya in #devex for style tips.

Samir Patel: once you have SSH keys in GitHub, clone with: git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/platform-core.git. Ill pair on your first PR.

Elliot Park: copying notes. thanks everyone for the quick help  looking forward to the 1:1 and maybe bringing salsa playlists to lunch :smile:
